newsitem.title: USA: EPA adds seven sites to Superfund toxic waste list.
newsitem.headline: EPA adds seven sites to Superfund toxic waste list.

text.p: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency said Friday it was adding seven sites and proposing to add five other sites to its list of dumps that need to be cleaned up under the Superfund toxic waste program.

The sites to be added are MRI Corp in Tampa, Florida, Stauffer Chemical Co in Tampa, Florida, Madisonville Creosote Works in Madisonville, Louisiana, Beede Waste Oil in Plaistow, New Hampshire, V&M/Albaladejo in Puerto Rico, Shuron Inc in Barnwell, South Carolina and Sharon Steel Corp in Fairmont, West Virginia.

The proposed sites are Brunswick Wood Preserving in Brunswick, Georgia, Grand Street Mercury in Hoboken, New Jersey, Ross Metals Inc in Rossville, Tennessee, Oeser Co in Bellingham, Washington, Palermo Well Field Ground Water Contamination in Tumwater, Washington.
